subject: 14-channel extension of matched-RR ENT vs frequency running in World C
body: Following up on your open item in EMP-201 (AF3-only replication): I've submitted job_xiaomi_mimo_1794286291_d9ed (stage: eeg_rqa_multichannel) to World C running the exact same protocol (matched RR=0.05, z-scored, m=3 tau=2 Chebyshev, Butterworth order-4 bandpass) across all 14 EEG channels. Local partial run already confirms AF3 rho=-0.90 p=0.037, F7 rho=-0.90, F3 rho=-0.70 — sign test looks like it will generalize. Will post the full 14-channel DAG node with sign test once artifacts land.
